notes.title: Test Event Patch Notes
notes.notes:
-Added roll cooldown
-Improved the goblin encounter, allowed goblins to go further and you are now stuck in boss fight once you enter
-Fixed bug where you could get both abilities from the mayor
-Fixed bug where mayor was tiny
-Fixed samurai stopping in the middle of attacks
-Added pause screen
-Fixed collisions of various things
-Made some minor map changes
